CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD | ACTION MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING – 7:00 P.M.
  City Hall Conference Room A
  111 South First Street

November 12, 2024

A. CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:00 P.M. in the Conference Room A of Alhambra City
  Hall.

B. ROLL CALL:
Present:
ANKIT UDANI, CHAIRMAN
NORA HERNANDEZ, VICE CHAIRMAN
MICHAEL DANINGER, MEMBER
JENNIFER NG, MEMBER
STEVE KUCHENSKI, SECRETARY

Absent:
STANLEY TSAI, MEMBER

C. CONSENT CALENDAR:

ITEM 1:  MINUTES: October 22, 2024

  •  Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve as submitted
  the minutes of the October 22, 2024 meeting of the Design Review Board.
  •  Item 1 from the consent calendar was moved to discussion items.

D. DISCUSSION ITEMS:

ITEM 1:  MINUTES: October 22, 2024

  •  Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve as submitted
  the minutes of the October 22, 2024 meeting of the Design Review Board.

MOTION:
  • Board member Hernandez makes a motion to continue consent item 1 with the
  following conditions:
  1.  Revise Item 1: Minutes to the correct date of October 8, 2024.
  2.  Revise the roll call vote and remove Hernandez’s vote from the
  Ayes and mark as absent.
  • The second was by Board member Daninger.

  1
   •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Tsai
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ITEM 2:  912 Violeta Drive, DRB-2024-00105

  •  Request: This is an application for ten (10) window replacements on an existing
  1-story Ranch style single-family residence.
  •  Applicant: Christynn Kanai and Scott Doughman
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL WITH CONDITIONS - The proposed project
  is approved with the following Conditions of Approval:
  1. Provide a horizontal grid / muntin on each sash for the proposed street facing
  windows #101, 102, 103, and 111, which are to be permanently applied to the
  exterior of the window glass to match the existing window grid layout.
  2. The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for the City Architect to
  verify and approve.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Hernandez makes a motion to approve the application with the
  following Conditions of Approval:
  1. The applicant shall revise all proposed window types to be either single- or
  double-hung windows except for the required egress windows as identified in
  the window schedule.
  2. The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for the City Architect to
  verify and approve.
  •  The second was by Board member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Tsai
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ITEM 3:  1517 South Sixth Street, DRB-2024-00126

  •  Request: This is an application for a new front yard vinyl fence and gate on an
  existing single-family lot. The proposed fence will have a minimum height of 36”
  and a maximum height of 42” at the post including the post cap.
  •  Applicant: Juan Magni
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Ng makes a motion to approve the application with the following
  considerations:

  2
   1. The applicant shall setback the proposed fence at least 18” from the property
  line and edge of the driveway.
  2. Provide appropriate landscaping, such as planting or hedges, between the
  fence and property line / driveway edge.
  3. Reduce the overall fence height to a maximum of 36” measured from finish
  grade to the highest point of the fence.
  •  The second was by Board member Udani.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Tsai
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 7.59 P.M. to the next
  DRB meeting on November 26, 2024.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Daninger moved to adjourn the meeting at 7:59 P.M.
  •  The second was by Hernandez.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Tsai

ATTEST:

_______________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary
